subject: prd/implement-now
statement: After direct issue admission, the executor shall reuse the existing bounded implementation worker, isolated workspaces, claims, routing, verification, code-host publication, and authenticated review machinery. Direct entry shall require a configured, usable independent reviewer before implementation spend, and shall report a verified PR only when the published proposal's current revision equals both the verified local/CI revision and its authenticated successful review revision. Implementation success and pending review shall retain their existing distinct truth.
rationale: a new input should not create a weaker executor or success predicate
fit_criterion: selected issue traverses the existing worker on each tracker and supported code host; disabled/unusable review fails before implementation; stale head/check/review or pending review never yields a verified-PR result; no merge occurs; existing activation controls are neither enabled nor bypassed
